description: Blood types and their quality-scaled bonuses. Filled by the cycle 2 bridge prefab dump. schema_version 2: a bonus entry names a slot (primary or secondary), a 1-based tier, the tier's buff prefab and the STAT NAMES it modifies. It carries no quality threshold and no magnitudes, because MEASURED against build 1.1.13.0-r99712 the prefab has neither: the two UnitBloodTypeBuffs buffer elements carry one PrefabGUID each and every Value on the tier buff reads 0, scaled from blood quality at runtime. core/table_deep.py asserts the nested shape; validate_table still only checks that bonuses is a list.

name.description: Resolved English display name, such as Warrior or Rogue.

bonuses.description: Bonus tiers, each with slot, tier, buff_guid, buff_name, a stats list of {stat, modification} and a value_source. Ordered by ascending tier within a slot.
